description: Look up what an LLM actually costs to call. Returns FIRST-PARTY list prices only — set by the lab that made the model, never a reseller or gateway markup — including the per-call server-side web-search fee that is billed ON TOP of tokens and is missing from every other public price table. Also returns long-context tier pricing, cached-input rates, release dates, and the exact timestamp each figure was last verified. Use when choosing a model on cost, estimating what a grounded answer will cost, or checking whether a price you have is current.

maxInputPerMtok.description: Max acceptable input price in USD per million tokens

model.description: Model id or name, full or partial, e.g. 'claude-sonnet' or 'gpt-5.6'

provider.description: Lab name or id, e.g. anthropic, openai, google, xai, mistral, deepseek

releasedWithinDays.description: Only models launched within this many days

sort.description: Order results by input price, output price, or release date (default)

name: stork_llm_prices
